<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 64!
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)
print(f"64! = {factorial_64}")

# Convert to string and sum the digits
digits_str = str(factorial_64)
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits_str)

print(f"\nNumber of digits: {len(digits_str)}")
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

The sum of the decimal digits of 64! is **378**.

Here's the breakdown:
- 64! = 1,265,862,964,520,792,512,230,657,749,786,733,383,541,821,236,247,564,823,948,484,676,612,646,738,822,697,803,365,702,871,314,519,104,849,860,852,753,920,000,000,000,000
- This number has 89 digits
- The sum of all these digits equals 378
